name: Bank of Tianjin Co., Ltd.
summary: Bank of Tianjin Co., Ltd. provides banking and related financial services in the People's Republic of China. The company operates through Corporate Banking, Personal Banking, and Treasury Operations segments. The Corporate Banking segment offers corporate loans, trade financing, deposit takings, and other corporate intermediary services to corporations, government agencies, and financial institutions. The Personal Banking segment provides personal loans, personal deposit, card business, personal wealth management services, and other personal intermediary services to individual customers.
